subject: Re: PoC next steps - deployment mode, success criteria, timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <s.martinez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Tom Rogers <t.rogers@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: PoC next steps - deployment mode, success criteria, timeline

Hi Sofia and Tom - thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the PoC scope:

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for customer-facing chat use-cases and validate cost at 95th percentile traffic.
- Data residency requirement: some logs must stay in their VPC / region for compliance, but no full model hosting on-prem initially.
- Primary stakeholders: Tom (Infra), Sofia (Product), Security to review SOC2 artifacts.

Initial ask from your side: confirm preferred deployment mode (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) for the PoC and any must-have success criteria. From our side we suggest a 3-week trial using Dedicated capacity (predictable throughput + isolated pool) as a middle ground unless you require full Private deployment.

Proposed PoC (draft):
- Duration: 3 weeks
- Model: Llama2-13B (quantized) - we can swap variants if you prefer a smaller / faster model
- Success criteria: 95th %ile latency < 300ms for single-turn chat; cost per 1k tokens below your target (please provide target); no sensitive data leaves your VPC (if Private chosen) or encrypted at rest + SOC2 controls if Hosted/Dedicated.
- Deliverables: test harness, traffic replay, perf dashboard access, final report.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (detailed tasks & timeline), soc2-summary.pdf (high level)

Next steps:
1) Confirm deployment mode preference and cost target for evaluation.
2) I'll schedule a 30-min alignment call with Marissa (solutions) and Dev (infra lead) to map technical requirements.
3) We'll send the formal PoC plan and scheduling calendar.

Thanks - happy to adjust.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.example.com

From: Sofia Martinez <s.martinez@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Tom Rogers <t.rogers@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC next steps - deployment mode, success criteria, timeline

Thanks Ben - great summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Deployment mode: we are inclined to start with Dedicated capacity for the PoC. Our security team is not ready to sign off on a Private deployment this quarter, but Dedicated with network peering and encrypted-at-rest logs should be acceptable for testing.

2) Success criteria: please use the following targets:
- 95th %ile latency < 350ms (single-turn)
- Throughput: sustain 40 rps for peak windows (we'll provide traffic replay)
- Cost: ideally <$0.50 per 1k tokens for the PoC baseline

3) Stakeholders: I'll loop in Security (Elena Morales) on the SOC2 review - she's out Tue/Wed but available after Thursday. Tom will own infra-specific configs.

We can do the 3-week PoC but would like a short pilot week (week 0) to validate connectivity and run a smoke test before the measurement window.

Can you include those updates in the PoC doc and set up the alignment call?

Best,
Sofia
Senior Product Manager | Acme Corp

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <s.martinez@acmecorp.com>, Tom Rogers <t.rogers@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC next steps - deployment mode, success criteria, timeline

Perfect - thanks Sofia. We'll update the PoC plan to: 1-week smoke pilot + 3-week measurement window, Dedicated capacity with peering, targets you listed.

Marissa / Dev, can you confirm the following from a technical delivery perspective?
- Dedicated pool sizing to handle 40 rps peak with room for burst (initial recommendation: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs; we'll adjust after replay data)
- Network peering steps and expected lead time (Tom, are there any firewall rules or IP allowlists we need?)
- Data handling: logs encrypted at rest and configurable retention; SOC2 artifacts attached for preliminary review.

I'll send an updated PoC doc and propose meeting slots for alignment (Thursday or Friday this week).

Thanks - Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Sofia Martinez <s.martinez@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.example.com>, Tom Rogers <t.rogers@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2026-06-12T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC next steps - deployment mode, success criteria, timeline

Hi all - quick technical notes from the solutions side:

- Pool sizing: for the replay profile you described (bursty traffic to 40 rps), 4 x A100-equivalent should be a safe starting point; we can enable autoscaling to handle short spikes. We'll provision a Dedicated pool for the PoC and keep telemetry visible in the Redwood Console.
- Model: Llama2-13B quantized gives a good balance; if latency looks tight we can test a 7B variant.
- Data flow: with peering, runtime logs can be sent to your log collector (we'll provide the host/IPs and ports). We do not persist PII in logs by default; retention is configurable.
- Timeline: Week 0 (smoke) - connectivity + smoke tests. Weeks 1-3 - measurement window. We'll aim to deliver the final report 3 business days after the window closes.

I attached the updated PoC plan with a proposed task-level timeline (redwood-poc-plan.pdf). I’ll join the alignment call and can run the smoke tests with Dev.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Tom Rogers <t.rogers@acmecorp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Sofia Martinez <s.martinez@acmecorp.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2026-06-15T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC next steps - deployment mode, success criteria, timeline

Thanks - we're aligned to proceed. A few quick infra notes:
- Peering: our network team needs a list of IP ranges and an expected maintenance window for setup.
- Firewall: we only allow outbound to specific hosts; please provide FQDNs and ports.
- Security review: Elena will pick this up Thursday; she asked for SOC2 scope and a sandbox access plan.

We can do an alignment call Friday 10:00am PT. I’ll invite our network engineer and Elena. If you can send the updated PoC doc and the one-week smoke test checklist beforehand that would be ideal.

Tom
Senior Infra Engineer | Acme Corp
